messages.subject: Machine Learning and Data Visualization - Free Seminars
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is pleased to be offering free introductions to Advanced Data Visualization and Machine Learning in February -- we hope to see you there:

Advanced Data Visualizations in R:Offered by the Statistical Society of Canada (Biostatistics Section) and McGill University, this 2-hour seminar running February 21st is perfect for anyone interested in learning more about creating publication-ready graphics and exploring interactive visualizations. Ideal for experienced R users looking to take their skills to the next level.

Machine Learning Essentials:Join Dr. Kimberly Fessel on February 5th for a concise introduction to machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and real-world applications. This 1-hour seminar is perfect for beginners or anyone seeking a quick refresher on machine learning methods.

Sign up today to secure your spot and please feel free to share with colleagues and students who might benefit.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
